title: GPA Calculator
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Calculate an unweighted GPA from your own courses and see how credits, single grades, and a college's core-only recalculation change the result.

learningObjectives: Students will calculate an unweighted GPA from a list of courses and demonstrate how a college's core-only recalculation can produce a different number.

controls: Add course, Remove last, Load Emily's year, and Show the math buttons

keyQuestions: Why does a half-credit course move the GPA less than a full-credit one?
Why might a college's core-only GPA differ from the one on your transcript?
When could dropping electives raise a GPA, and when could it lower it?
commonMisconceptions: Every course counts equally no matter its credits.
Colleges always use the GPA printed on the transcript.
assessmentOpportunities: Students calculate an unweighted GPA by hand for a new set of courses, match the calculator's result, and explain why the core-only GPA differs.
